capabilities.description: Track active jobs, sites and work fronts with milestones, progress percentage, snag/punch lists, and variations with their approval status.

BOQ line items and measured quantities, interim payment applications and valuations, retention, variation orders, invoices and supplier/subcontractor purchase orders and payment tracking — in AED, with UAE VAT applied and unspecified tax/regulatory handling kept configurable.
Upload and index BOQs, drawings, method statements, safety procedures and subcontractor/supplier price lists, and answer questions against them with source references.
Per-job method statement and safety procedure records, incident/near-miss logging, and readiness checks before a work front opens.
Cross-job roll-up showing progress, certified value, cost to date, variations pending, snags open and payments due.
Scheduled reminder to prepare the monthly interim payment application/valuation, and escalation when variations or snags accumulate beyond a threshold on a job.
Full audit trail of approvals, document versions and financial changes, with role-based access for owner, site engineer/foreman and accounts.
Notify the team by email and/or messaging channel on approvals, due valuations and overdue items.

settings.UAE_VAT_RATE_PERCENT: required, no default — the contractor's own VAT position decides the rate
